race.description: Peter Smith Memorial Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: TEMPESTUOUS (3) good type who went under narrowly on debut in the G3 Breeders' Plate on October 5, 2024 and resumes a gelding. His two subsequent runs had merit behind O'Ole and Gallo Nero in stronger company. Back with the two trials and can overcome the awkward gate. WRITTEN DOLL (4) has finished runner-up at his two starts back and doesn't have to improve much to win this. Went out quickly and gripped on late for a close second over 1200m at Illawarra Grange. Stalks the speed and will take holding out. HARRYBEGOOD (8) resumes. Gelded over the break and James McDonald takes the reins from the right draw. Showed enough in the first prep and fitted with the two searching trials in readiness for this. Big market watch. PROFITABELLE (13) nice filly resuming. Held in high regard by the stable and expected to progress quickly this time in. Raced much closer in her two recent trials and has the upside to get the better of these. The chances don't end there.
